No use case builds DTO objects inline or skips the mappers. It is a small piece of repeated boilerplate that could become a helper, but it is a lookup guard, not a business rule or invariant split across places. ListStockLevelsUseCase deals with products rather than orders, but it fits the same inventory/order application boundary.
